meaning: The bright-galaxy ball as dots: one in 3 of the tracked DESI sample (one in 10 of the catalogue) on DESI's footprint, and one in 3 of the WISE x SuperCOSMOS fill, at DESI's density in each redshift bin, everywhere else the Milky Way does not hide.

banks.basis: Presentation choice: the two samples together hold 88,218 galaxies and a bank draws at most 40,000 (MAX_CATALOGUE_POINTS), so both keep one in 3 and stay at one density: 29,407 dots, about as many as DESI's cones alone drew before.
Presentation choice: the same share as DESI's, so the ball stays even.
